ClientCreateRequest.description: POST /api/v1/clients body. Required: lastName, firstName, phone.
ClientCreateRequest.title: ClientCreateRequest

ClientResponse.description:
Single client read DTO. `from_attributes=True` (inherited via ContractModel)
allows `ClientResponse.model_validate(orm_client_instance)`.

`deleted_at` is intentionally omitted — soft-deleted rows are 404'd at the
repository boundary (Plan 04 `get_alive`); the response shape never carries it.
ClientResponse.title: ClientResponse

ClientUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /api/v1/clients/{id} body.

Semantics: caller sends only the fields they want to change; service does
`model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` and applies that subset. D-01 forbids explicit
null in v1.1 — to leave a field unchanged, OMIT the key entirely.
ClientUpdateRequest.title: ClientUpdateRequest

EmergencyContact.title: EmergencyContact

Gender.title: Gender

MembershipCancelRequest.description:
POST /api/v1/memberships/{id}/cancel body (Phase 17 D-11).

Reason is optional (matches MEM-AUDIT-01 — `reason?` in audit payload).
Max length 500 — half the notes ceiling: a cancellation reason is a short
operator note, not a free-form essay (T-17-01 mitigation).

Explicit-null guard ported VERBATIM from Phase 16 D-05 (T-PYDANTIC-NULL).
MembershipCancelRequest.title: MembershipCancelRequest

MembershipCreateRequest.description:
POST /api/v1/memberships body (Phase 17 D-03).

start_date / end_date / status / activation_policy are server-computed
(D-04) and intentionally absent — the inherited extra='forbid' will reject
any payload that includes them.
MembershipCreateRequest.title: MembershipCreateRequest

MembershipPlanSort.description: Membership plan list sort modes (D-08, CD-04).
MembershipPlanSort.title: MembershipPlanSort

MembershipPlanUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /api/v1/membership-plans/{id} body.

D-04: duration_days is intentionally absent — extra='forbid' (inherited
from BackendSchemaBase) raises stock 422 if a payload contains
`durationDays` (or `duration_days`). The rejected key is named in the
Pydantic error response.
MembershipPlanUpdateRequest.title: MembershipPlanUpdateRequest

MembershipResponse.description:
Outbound representation of a Membership (Phase 17 D-10).

Exposes ALL snapshot fields so the frontend (Phase 22) can render
historical sales correctly even after the source plan is edited or
deleted.
MembershipResponse.title: MembershipResponse

VisitsMetaResponse.description:
GET /api/v1/visits/_meta response (Phase 22 D-22-1).

Returns gym hours window as HH:MM strings. Serialises from Settings
(lru_cache) — no DB access. Cache-Control: public, max-age=300.
VisitsMetaResponse.title: VisitsMetaResponse

post.description: Authenticate email+password; issue cookies + envelope (AUTH-EP-01..02, AUTH-EP-05).

Revoke current family + clear cookies (AUTH-LO-01).

Idempotent: if the refresh cookie is absent or already revoked, the cookie
clear still runs so the browser ends in a clean state.
Revoke ALL alive families for the user + clear caller's cookies (AUTH-LO-02).

get.description:
Return the authenticated user's profile (AUTH-LO-04).

`CurrentUser` is a Protocol with `id` + `role` only. The route knows the
runtime instance is the SA `User` model (registered via register_user_loader
in app.main.create_app), so we cast for access to email / full_name /
telegram_chat_id. The cast is safe because the loader is fixed at composition.

post.description:
Rotate the refresh token; reissue all three cookies (AUTH-05/06).

Reads `sz_refresh` cookie directly (NOT via the auth dep — an expired
access token must NOT block a refresh call). The body is empty on
success: the new tokens travel in cookies. CSRF dep is exempt (Phase 6
CSRF-02 / D-09 list).

Mint a deep-link token (AUTH-TG-01).

Returns the deep-link URL the FE shows to the operator. The OtpCode row
is created with code_hash=NULL — the bot will fill it after /start <token>.

get.description:
Poll: has the bot DMed the code yet? (AUTH-TG-03).

Per D-19: never raises; unknown / expired / consumed all return bound=False
(do NOT leak token validity).

post.description:
Verify the 6-digit OTP and issue session cookies (AUTH-TG-04, AUTH-TG-06).

On success: mints tokens + cookies identical to /login, then emits
`login_success` with `channel='telegram'` (D-14). Distinct error codes
per D-13 ride the AppError envelope handler. BotNotStarted is re-raised
with `fields={'deepLinkUrl': ...}` so the FE can re-display the deep-link
button (D-13 row 1).

get.description: List alive clients (CLIENTS-03/04). VIEW permission required (D-21).
get.summary: List alive clients with filters and pagination

post.description: Create a client (CLIENTS-06). EDIT permission + CSRF required (D-21).

delete.description:
Soft-delete an alive client (CLIENTS-08).

Owner-only: (DELETE, CLIENTS) is in OWNER_ONLY, so reception → 403 from
require_permission. CSRF required on the mutation. Returns 204 No Content;
FastAPI emits an empty body for 204 status_code.
delete.summary: Soft-delete a client (owner-only; sets deleted_at, never hard-deletes)

get.description: Read one alive client (CLIENTS-05). 404 for missing or soft-deleted ids.
get.summary: Get a single alive client by id (404 if soft-deleted or missing)

patch.description: Partial update of an alive client (CLIENTS-07). EDIT + CSRF (D-21).
patch.summary: Partial update (PATCH semantics; null-out via PATCH not supported in v1.1)

get.description: List alive membership plans (MEM-PLAN-EP-01). VIEW permission required.
get.summary: List alive membership plans (owner-only); paginated; ?active filter

post.description: Create a membership plan (MEM-PLAN-EP-02). CREATE permission + CSRF required.
post.summary: Create a membership plan (owner-only; 409 plan_name_exists on duplicate alive name)

delete.description:
Soft-delete an alive membership plan (MEM-PLAN-EP-04).

Owner-only: (DELETE, MEMBERSHIP_PLANS) is in OWNER_ONLY, so reception → 403 from
require_permission. CSRF required on the mutation. Returns 204 No Content.

D-15: Phase 16 ships soft-delete only — no 409 plan_in_use. The memberships table
FK plan_id ON DELETE RESTRICT and _is_plan_in_use_conflict helper arrive in Phase 17.
delete.summary: Soft-delete a membership plan (owner-only); frees lower(name) unique slot

get.description: Read one alive membership plan. 404 for missing or soft-deleted ids.
get.summary: Fetch a single alive membership plan (owner-only)

patch.description: Partial update of an alive membership plan (MEM-PLAN-EP-03). EDIT + CSRF required.
patch.summary: Patch a membership plan (owner-only); durationDays is immutable (rejected with 422)

get.description:
List memberships, paginated (MEM-EP-01).

Query parameters (Phase 17 D-09):
  - clientId — optional UUID filter; omit for global feed (owner)
  - status   — optional single-value enum (active|expired|cancelled); omit for all
  - sort     — created_at_desc (default) | end_date_desc | start_date_desc
  - page / pageSize — PageQuery contract (default 1 / 20, max 100)
get.summary: List memberships filtered by clientId/status with pagination

post.description:
Sell a membership (MEM-EP-03). CREATE permission + CSRF required.

(CREATE, MEMBERSHIPS) is NOT in OWNER_ONLY — reception receives 201 on success.
Service layer validates plan presence (404 plan_not_found) and active flag
(409 plan_inactive) and computes start_date/end_date server-side (D-04).

get.description: Read one membership (MEM-EP-02). 404 `membership_not_found` for missing ids.
get.summary: Get a membership by id (404 membership_not_found)

post.description:
Cancel a membership (MEM-EP-04). Owner-only — reception → 403 from RBAC gate.

(CANCEL, MEMBERSHIPS) is in OWNER_ONLY (Phase 15 INFRA-08). CSRF required on
the mutation. Returns 200 with the cancelled MembershipResponse (NOT 204 —
the body carries the post-transition row including `cancelled_at`).

State machine (Phase 17 D-12): only `active → cancelled` is allowed; `expired`
and `cancelled` source states raise 409 `invalid_transition` with payload
`{from_status, to_status}`.
post.summary: Cancel a membership (owner-only; 409 invalid_transition for non-active source)

get.description: List visits, paginated (VIS-EP-01). VIEW permission required.
get.summary: List visits filtered by clientId/from/to with pagination

post.description:
Reception manual check-in (VIS-EP-03). CHECK_IN permission + CSRF required.

Sealed body — only `clientId` accepted (D-01). Every other field is
server-derived: membershipId resolved via resolve_active_membership;
checkedInAt defaults to DB now(); gymDate is the STORED GENERATED column;
channel is 'reception'; checkedInBy is actor.id.

RBAC-04: `actor` (require_permission) parameter is declared BEFORE
`_csrf` (verify_csrf) so unauthenticated callers see 401, not CSRF
errors. (CHECK_IN, VISITS) is NOT in OWNER_ONLY — reception receives
201 on success.
post.summary: Reception manual check-in (reception+owner; 409 outside_gym_hours / no_active_membership / duplicate_checkin)

get.description:
Return gym hours window. Reception + owner. No DB access.

Cache-Control: public, max-age=300 — value travels with route (D-22-1).
Reads Settings.gym_hours_start / gym_hours_end (lru_cache) and serialises
via .isoformat()[:5] → HH:MM strings.
Read one visit (VIS-EP-02). 404 `visit_not_found` for missing ids.
get.summary: Get a single visit by id (404 visit_not_found)
